name: codex-dsh-web
description: Drive and verify DSH Web sessions from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to local DSH Web sessions.
interface.longDescription: Create and reuse DSH Web sessions, exchange prompts over its local HTTP API, inspect results, and feed Codex verification back into the same session.
defaultPrompt: Use DSH Web to implement this task, then verify its changes.
Continue this task in the existing DSH Web session.
Ask DSH Web to fix the failing tests and validate the result.
